name: Locator.X
tagline: Real-estate development and investment predictive tooling, plus the Academy that teaches it

zones.name: Master Dashboard
zones.purpose: Central hub: portfolio summary, cross-market comparison and navigation to market editions

zones.name: Underwriting Desk
zones.purpose: Maps, scores and underwrites parcels; runs the seven-gate LOCATOR screen; break-even at DSCR 1.20
zones.source: ~/Downloads/Locator.X-main/docs/OVERVIEW.md, §2 The three layers and §3 The LOCATOR framework

zones.name: Evidence Layer
zones.purpose: Grades every number shown: coverage before any rate, sample floor of 5, explicit list of unknowns

zones.name: The Academy
zones.purpose: 19 tracks, 92 lessons, 50 curriculum items teaching how to read what the platform produces

zones.name: Market Editions
zones.purpose: National corridor baseline, Bay Area premium and New Orleans emerging-market maps

zones.name: Louisiana Developer Desk
zones.purpose: Parish-by-parish record coverage, named data traps, cancelled capital weighted to zero

agents.name: Guide
agents.role: Persistent floating assistant: guided tour of every section and live search over help text

agents.name: Forecast Agent
agents.role: Predictive models over the ZIP value series with point forecast and ~80% band

agents.name: Scout Agent
agents.role: Scans feeds, diffs, scores and matches new listings and changes

agents.name: Review Agent
agents.role: Produces a review digest per scan pass, incl. 12-month re-underwrite flip scan

agents.name: Level Gates
agents.role: Grades curriculum levels as capabilities on a real parcel; counts certainty errors
agents.source: ~/Downloads/Locator.X-main/README.md, The Academy > What makes it testable (src/gate.js)

agents.name: Developer Brief Desk
agents.role: Role-only agent: tells a developer what the parish record supports and what it caps at

gaps: No source describes a 3D/RP1 world, spatial layout or reason for the Pacific anchor coordinates
